title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://dpaste.org/qAr9p/raw (OffSeq Mirage)
description: An attacker URL linked to CVE-2021-42013 was observed in the wild by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-31. The URL was seen five times in attacker activity originating from infrastructure in India. The activity involved the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating the URL was used for payload delivery or exploitation. Organizations are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, or WAF logs for any requests to it.
